audit_metadata.title: Horner Cscape Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server - Security & Hardware Lockout Audit

zero_physical_plc_download.policy: Controller download commands are unconditionally blocked fail-closed.

zero_physical_port_access.policy: No physical serial, COM, LPT, CAN, or USB ports can be accessed or configured.

zero_disallowed_binaries.policy: Flashing utilities and dangerous executables are intercepted and blocked before invocation.

zero_straton_k5_dependencies.policy: Legacy standalone Straton K5 project files (.k5p, appli.CPO) quarantined; pure IEC 61131-3 ST AST parser and native Cscape CFBF OLE2 envelope enforced.

tests/test_security.py.focus: Safety policy invariants, port blocklists, binary blocking, path sandbox, and decorators

audit_conclusion.summary: All 23 FastMCP tools registered on MCPServer strictly adhere to the Horner Cscape Hardware Lockout Policy. Controller download command IDs (32827, 33149) are unconditionally blocked, physical communication ports (COM/CAN/USB) are denied, prohibited flashing binaries are blocked by SafetyGuard, and legacy Straton K5 dependencies are quarantined. All 382 dedicated safety and security tests pass with 0 failures.
